title: Conditional-Expectation Value Guarantee
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, let a finite CSP template over $D$ and a finite CSP instance with at least one constraint be given, and let the input include a randomized assignment. The expected fraction of satisfied constraints is at most the fraction satisfied by the assignment produced by the input’s conditional-expectation plan.
